headline: Xi gives Trump a warm welcome ahead of Putin-China trilateral meeting
summary: Trump arrived in Shenzhen, China, after a two-hour flight from the Philippines and was greeted warmly by Xi Jinping ahead of a historic trilateral meeting with Vladimir Putin.
why: Relations among the United States, China and Russia shape trade flows, sanctions exposure and energy and commodity markets. Summit diplomacy can shift expectations for those flows.
original_headline: Xi da cálida bienvenida a Trump antes reunión trilateral Putin China
